Kestrel.// Certificates: the ASP.NET dev cert exported per machine with `dotnet dev-certs https --export-path web/.certs/localhost.pem --format Pem --no-password` (see CLAUDE.md); paths are relative to src/TaskOTron.Api

Auth.// Username: set via `dotnet user-secrets set Auth:Username <name>` (dev) or the Auth__Username env var (prod) — never commit real values here
Auth.// PasswordHash: set via `dotnet user-secrets set Auth:PasswordHash <hash>`, where <hash> comes from `dotnet run --project src/TaskOTron.Api -- hash-password <password>`
